description: This file defines the 'Thing' interface in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package, representing a generic entity for IoT devices and virtual objects with extensive methods for managing attributes, features, lifecycle, access control, and metadata.

classes.name: JsonFields
classes.description: A container of JSON field definitions for serialization/deserialization of Thing properties and metadata.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder to construct a Thing from scratch.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder initialized with the current instance for modifications.

methods.name: getImplementedSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the schema version implemented by this Thing, based on access control and policy presence.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace of the Thing derived from its ID.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the attributes associated with the Thing.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Thing with specified attributes set.

methods.name: removeAttributes
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Thing with all attributes removed.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the entity.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a hierarchical attribute value based on the path and value.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes an attribute at the specified path.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns the Thing's definition, if any.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Sets the definition of this Thing.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Removes the Thing's definition.

methods.name: setFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Sets the definition for a specific feature.

methods.name: removeFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Removes a feature's definition.

methods.name: setFeatureProperties
methods.description: Sets properties for a specific feature.

methods.name: setFeatureProperty
methods.description: Sets a property within a feature.

methods.name: removeFeatureProperties
methods.description: Removes all properties from a feature.

methods.name: removeFeatureProperty
methods.description: Removes a specific property from a feature.

methods.name: getLifecycle
methods.description: Returns the current lifecycle state.

methods.name: setLifecycle
methods.description: Sets a new lifecycle state.

methods.name: hasLifecycle
methods.description: Checks if the Thing has a specific lifecycle.

methods.name: getAccessControlList
methods.description: Returns the access control list, deprecated in favor of policies.

methods.name: setAccessControlList
methods.description: Sets the ACL, deprecated.

methods.name: setAclEntry
methods.description: Adds or updates an ACL entry, deprecated.

methods.name: removeAllPermissionsOf
methods.description: Removes permissions for a given authorization subject, deprecated.

methods.name: getPolicyId
methods.description: Returns the Policy ID as String, deprecated.

methods.name: setPolicyId
methods.description: Sets the Policy ID as String, deprecated.

methods.name: getPolicyEntityId
methods.description: Returns the typed PolicyId, preferred method.

methods.name: getFeatures
methods.description: Returns features associated with the Thing.

methods.name: setFeatures
methods.description: Sets the features of the Thing.

methods.name: removeFeatures
methods.description: Removes all features.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Adds or replaces a specific feature.

methods.name: removeFeature
methods.description: Removes a feature by ID.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Method for validation, does nothing anymore, deprecated.
